definition: Diffbot is a developer of machine learning and computer vision algorithms and public APIs for extracting data from web pages / web scraping to create a knowledge base.
details: Diffbot is a developer of machine learning and computer vision algorithms and public APIs for extracting data from web pages / web scraping to create a knowledge base.

explainer.lead: Diffbot is a company that builds machine-learning and computer-vision tools for turning web pages into structured data. Its public APIs support web scraping and the creation of a knowledge base, reducing the need to read and organize page content manually.

tiers.eli5: Imagine a robot reader that visits web pages and turns what it finds into neat notes. Diffbot makes tools that do this automatically, so information scattered across websites can be collected and organized into one useful knowledge base.
tiers.practitioner: An engineer can use Diffbot's public APIs to extract data from web pages and feed the results into a knowledge base or another downstream system. Extracted records should be validated before use, and extraction jobs should be monitored because page structures and content can vary.
tiers.paperLevel: In plain-text terms, Diffbot applies machine-learning and computer-vision algorithms to a web page p to produce extracted structured data d, which can then be incorporated into a knowledge base K. Its public APIs expose this extraction process for web-scraping applications; extraction quality depends on how well the algorithms interpret each page's content and structure.

explainer.example: A developer submits a product page through a public API, receives structured fields such as its title, price, and description, and adds that record to a knowledge base of products.
